name: aviasales-mcp
description: Search cached Aviasales flight prices and look up airport codes.
long_description: Read-only flight search for Aviasales and Travelpayouts: fares by route and month, the cheapest day to fly, flexible dates, budget search, and airline, airport, city, and country lookup. Prices are per adult in economy. To run it you need a free Travelpayouts API token; an optional two-letter market selects which price cache to read.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Travelpayouts API token. The server sends it as AVIASALES_API_TOKEN.

market.title: Market
market.description: 2-letter market whose price cache to read (unset means ru). The same route in the same currency is priced differently per market.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search flight prices between two cities on a date or across a month.

tools.name: get_prices_calendar
tools.description: Get grouped calendar prices for a route, one fare per day or per month.

tools.name: get_flexible_date_prices
tools.description: Compare prices for the days around a departure and an optional return.

tools.name: get_latest_prices
tools.description: Get the most recently found flight prices from other travellers' searches.

tools.name: get_popular_directions
tools.description: List the cities people most often fly to a destination from, with a fare.

tools.name: get_city_directions
tools.description: List the cheapest destinations reachable from a city, with a fare and dates.

tools.name: get_alternative_directions
tools.description: Get prices for nearby airports and cities around a chosen route.

tools.name: search_by_price_range
tools.description: Find flights whose cached fare falls inside a minimum and maximum price.

tools.name: lookup_airlines
tools.description: Look up airlines by name or IATA code.

tools.name: lookup_airports
tools.description: Look up airports by name, IATA code, or city code.

tools.name: lookup_cities
tools.description: Look up cities by name or IATA code and return the code flight tools expect.

tools.name: lookup_countries
tools.description: Look up countries by name or two-letter country code.

tools.name: find_nearest_airports
tools.description: Find the airports closest to a place name or to a latitude and longitude.
